actor_instance: MFM published source review to FBM procedure capture
goal: Turn the observed missing-PIL lazy processor failure into a reproducible, source-bound target-container diagnostic without reporting an unrun repair as a pass.
procedure: Stage pillow-11.3.0-cp311-cp311-manylinux_2_27_x86_64.manylinux_2_28_x86_64.whl under the mounted owner compute root and verify SHA-256 106064daa23a745510dabce1d84f29137a37224831d88eb4ce94bb187b1d7e5f. The published Slurm launcher installs it offline with no dependencies into a fresh per-job MFM directory, leaving the shared N0 udocker image unchanged. Inside that same target udocker runtime, assert PIL 11.3.0 resolves from the isolated directory, import PIL.Image and PIL._imaging, pin Transformers 5.17.0, and actually call AutoProcessor.from_pretrained on the local Gemma 4 clone with remote code and network disabled. Require multimodal processor attributes before the trainer's 23.9 GB clone rehash and public 21-case processor pass. Only a new completed job-specific receipt may advance that diagnostic gate.
decision_criteria: launcher checks exact wheel filename and SHA-256 before use
per-job isolated Pillow target and local processor construction precede expensive role-clone rehash
new source revision requires a fresh job and receipt rather than reinterpreting failed job 576488
authority: Published source procedure only. Neither staged wheel bytes nor a corrected Magnolia execution or processor receipt has been observed here. The historical 576488 failure remains on MFM 412ae32a; source/clone custody from 576486 remains owner-verified metadata, with no processor, model, training, gold or product promotion.
validation: git ls-remote matched published MFM commit 079c010c0c93e3d02352cfe8c20b502c46c8cfd3; local published tree matches 11aa22b85c75dcc8f097609800780ea2fddb8860; bash -n passed for the launcher and source inspection located exact wheel check, isolated install and early AutoProcessor load. No target-container retry has run.
failure_or_lesson: A lazy backend can fail after imports and version checks pass. Preflight the exact processor under the same isolated runtime that will process data, preserve the failed source lineage, and wait for a completed receipt before counting a repair as working.
